experiment: Stage5 P2-H terminal-aware prioritized critic replay A/B

scientific_conclusion.inference: The 10k agents did not demonstrate clean driving. The terminal replay mechanism was not activated because online replay contained only timeouts and nonterminal transitions. P2-H cannot determine whether terminal-aware replay would help when useful terminal records exist.

status_reason: Arm B observed zero eligible clean or safety terminal transitions at every checkpoint and therefore used uniform fallback for the entire run.

The implementation used an independent uniform actor/alpha batch in B while control A retained SB3's shared uniform batch; this changes critic/actor minibatch coupling, so post hoc A/B differences cannot be attributed to terminal prioritization.
